rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a child's allowance or a small amount of money for everyday spending.

example.english: My mum gives me pocket money every week so I can buy stationery and snacks.
example.traditional: 媽媽每個星期畀我零用錢，等我買文具同小食。
example.jyutping: maa4 maa1 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 bei2 ngo5 ling4 jung6 cin2 dang2 ngo5 maai5 man4 geoi6 tung4 siu2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when the money specifically means coins or small change carried for minor purchases.

example.english: I still have some pocket money in loose change in my wallet, just enough to buy a bottle of water.
example.traditional: 我個銀包入面仲有啲零錢，買支水啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 di1 ling4 cin4 maai5 zi1 seoi2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2
